title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.08752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. Although safety can be improved through model fine-tuning, such approaches can be computationally expensive and may degrade previously acquired capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Recent jailbreak defenses have therefore explored targeted interventions on specific model components associated with unsafe behavior. However, existing approaches typically decouple two inherently related decisions: where to intervene and how to modify the selected components. translated_title: AttentionSwitch：通过稀疏注意力头选择与缩放的联合学习实现大语言模型的越狱防御
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在广泛的任务中取得了卓越的性能，但仍然容易受到越狱攻击的影响，这类攻击会绕过安全机制并引发有害或非预期的输出。虽然可以通过模型微调来提升安全性，但此类方法的计算成本可能很高，并且可能由于灾难性遗忘而损害模型先前获得的能力。因此，近期的越狱防御工作开始探索对与不安全行为相关的特定模型组件进行有针对性的干预。然而，现有方法通常将两个本质上相关的决策解耦处理：在哪里进行干预以及如何修改所选组件。这种顺序式优化可能是次优的，因为最佳的干预位置可能取决于在该处施加的干预方式，反之亦然。在这项工作中，我们提出了AttentionSwitch，这是首个联合优化干预位置与干预方式的越狱防御方法。
tldr: AttentionSwitch是首个通过联合学习稀疏注意力头的选择与缩放，同时优化越狱防御中“在哪里干预”和“如何干预”两个决策的大语言模型防御方法。
en_tdlr: AttentionSwitch is the first jailbreak defense for LLMs that jointly learns sparse attention-head selection and scaling, simultaneously optimizing both where and how to intervene.
